intro: Where2Place 是 Gemini Robotics 报告引用的空间推理 benchmark，用于评估模型判断物体放置位置的能力。

drawio_review_note: Aligned with RoboPoint arXiv:2406.10721, Section 5.1 'Spatial Affordance Prediction,' especially the Benchmarks paragraph and Table 2; official project https://robo-point.github.io/, repository https://github.com/wentaoyuan/RoboPoint, and dataset https://huggingface.co/datasets/wentao-yuan/where2place. The paper explicitly states that 'a subset of 30 examples (Where2Place(h))' contains relation types absent from the synthetic data, so Hard 30 overlaps the full 100-example benchmark. Scope pin: this entry covers Where2Place, not RoboPoint's 660K-example synthetic training-data pipeline.. Where2Place contains 100 real-world images from homes and offices. To reduce annotation bias, one group writes an instruction describing a vacant region relative to scene entities, while a different group independently labels the target mask from that instruction. These annotations form the full 100 image-instruction-mask triples. Where2Place(h) is an overlapping subset of 30 examples from the full benchmark whose relation types do not occur in RoboPoint's synthetic training data; it is not a disjoint split. During evaluation, a model predicts one or more points directly, while bounding-box baselines are converted by evenly sampling points. Accuracy is the percentage of predicted points inside the target mask, and Table 2 reports mean and standard deviation over three runs for the full 100 examples and the overlapping Hard 30 subset.
